question: By how much could direct recycling reduce greenhouse gas and SOx emissions from cathode material production, according to Dunn et al.?
rendered: According to the text, Dunn et al. estimated that direct recycling could reduce greenhouse gas emissions from cathode material production by 81-98% and SOx emissions by 72% to nearly 100%.
